releaseNotes: KabirUI 4.0 adds Wallpaper Studio with 20 new wallpapers, KabirUI Market, expanded widget styles and colors, Quick Search app actions, swipe-up shortcuts, and more customization.

changes.title: Wallpaper Studio
changes.detail: Reframe personal photos with a live home preview, zoom, color tones, and readability dimming saved per Home Mode.

changes.title: Twenty new wallpapers
changes.detail: Explore twenty original scenes across abstract, nature, AMOLED, floral, and architecture styles.

changes.title: Wallpaper search
changes.detail: Find wallpapers by name, category, or description.

changes.title: Wallpaper favorites
changes.detail: Save wallpapers to a Favorites filter and keep the list in your backup.

changes.title: More widget styles
changes.detail: Browse all 58 clock and battery designs during setup, filter to the newest looks, and choose sizes up to 4×4.

changes.title: Clock typefaces
changes.detail: Set each clock to follow KabirUI, sans serif, serif, monospace, or cursive.

changes.title: Clock text colors
changes.detail: Choose from fourteen named colors plus the style-matched default, including cobalt, mauve, terracotta, and olive.

changes.title: Battery accent colors
changes.detail: Choose one of twelve named accents or follow battery status; hide the percentage, charge-state label, or charging icon on each widget.

changes.title: Quick Search app actions
changes.detail: Open app options from the visible menu beside a search result.

changes.title: Swipe-up shortcuts
changes.detail: Choose App drawer, Quick search, or Off for swiping up on the home screen.

changes.title: Eight more wallpapers
changes.detail: Add Lotus Afterglow, Tidal Glass, Solar Loom, Mosslight, Porcelain Sky, Prismfall, Velvet Skyline, and Perigee to the market.

changes.title: Battery background opacity
changes.detail: Tune each battery widget’s surface transparency to show more of your wallpaper.

changes.title: Independent charging icon
changes.detail: Show or hide the charging bolt separately from the battery status label.

changes.title: Eight new wallpapers
changes.detail: Browse Glacier Bloom, Copper Atlas, Glass Orchid, Orchard Light, Lunar Library, Coral Tide, Dune Script, and Ink Current.

changes.title: Battery reading fallback
changes.detail: Use Android’s battery-capacity property when a device sends incomplete battery extras. Thanks to @NicoloM for catching the Galaxy S9 case.

changes.title: Clock seconds display
changes.detail: Optionally show seconds across digital clock layouts and a moving second hand on analog designs.

changes.title: Weather widget details
changes.detail: Show or hide hourly forecast and humidity, wind, and rain details separately on larger weather widgets.

changes.title: Seven more wallpapers
changes.detail: Add Tideglass, Verdant Afterglow, Opal Veil, Ember Dunes, Polar Silence, Orchid Halo, and Copper Rain to Wallpaper Market.

changes.title: KabirUI Market
changes.detail: Open KabirUI Market and Wallpaper Market from the drawer by default; add or remove optional apps like Today Page, Home Modes, Universal Font, and Adaptive Home.

changes.title: Ten AMOLED wallpapers
changes.detail: Add Pulsar Gate, Moonlit Orbit, Violet Supercluster, Solar Ember, Saturn Shadow, Far Reach, Celestial Current, Graviton, Comet Wake, and Blue Dwarf.

changes.title: Ten new clock and battery styles
changes.detail: Add ten new clock looks and ten battery designs, all previewable in setup and responsive from 1×1 through 4×4.
